meta.heading: ACHIEVEMENTS
meta.subheading: Our milestones, awards, and proud moments on the competitive stage.

timeline.title: IIT Roorkee – Nano Navigator
timeline.description: Secured 1st place in Nano Navigator at IIT Roorkee, demonstrating precision autonomous navigation and control.

timeline.title: IIT Roorkee – Robo Soccer
timeline.description: Secured 3rd place in Robo Soccer at IIT Roorkee, demonstrating multi-agent coordination, real-time control, and strategic gameplay.

timeline.title: Charusat – RC Car
timeline.description: Secured 2nd place in RC Car competition at Charusat, highlighting precision driving, control tuning, and performance optimization.

timeline.title: ITM – RC Car
timeline.description: Achieved 2nd place in RC Car racing at ITM, showcasing high-speed control, stability, and efficient mechanical design.

timeline.title: SVNIT Mindbend – Maze Solver
timeline.description: Secured 3rd place in Maze Solver at SVNIT Mindbend, demonstrating efficient path planning and autonomous navigation algorithms.

timeline.title: SVNIT Mindbend – CosmoClench Bot
timeline.description: Achieved 3rd place in CosmoClench Bot event, showcasing robotic manipulation and control precision under competitive conditions.

timeline.title: SVNIT Mindbend – RC Car
timeline.description: Secured 2nd place in RC Car racing, demonstrating high-speed control, stability, and optimized mechanical performance.

timeline.title: SVNIT Mindbend – Robo Soccer
timeline.description: Achieved 2nd place in Robo Soccer, highlighting multi-robot coordination, real-time control, and strategic gameplay execution.

timeline.title: IIT Bombay – CosmoClench Bot
timeline.description: Secured 3rd place in CosmoClench Bot at IIT Bombay, demonstrating precise robotic manipulation and control under competitive conditions.

timeline.title: Prevoyance, Nirma – RC Car Sumo
timeline.description: Secured 1st place in RC Car Sumo at Prevoyance, Nirma University, demonstrating high-power control, mechanical robustness, and competitive strategy.

timeline.title: VIC Vadodara – AV Club Representation
timeline.description: Represented the AV Club at VIC Vadodara with Hexapod and Maze Solver projects, showcasing real-world robotics applications and engaging with the innovation community.

timeline.title: Robofest 5.0 – Autonomous Rover
timeline.description: Developed and showcased an autonomous rover at Robofest 5.0, capable of terrain traversal, obstacle avoidance, and real-time navigation inspired by Mars rover systems.

timeline.title: Robofest 5.0 – Swarm Robotics
timeline.description: Developed and showcased a swarm robotics system at Robofest 5.0, focusing on multi-agent coordination, communication protocols, and decentralized control.

timeline.title: Ingenium – Line Follower
timeline.description: Secured 2nd place in Line Follower competition at Ahmedabad University, demonstrating precise path tracking and control system tuning.

timeline.title: Makers Fest (VIC) – Platinum Award
timeline.description: Awarded Platinum recognition at Makers Fest (VIC, MSU) for outstanding project innovation and technical execution.

timeline.title: Robofest 4.0 – Maze, Submarine & Hexapod
timeline.description: Led multiple project teams at Robofest 4.0, Maze Solver, Submarine, and Hexapod systems , demonstrating versatility across autonomous navigation, aquatic robotics, and multi-legged locomotion.

timeline.title: FP25 – Ballista
timeline.description: Secured 1st place in Ballista event at FP25 (MSU), demonstrating precision targeting and mechanical system design.

timeline.title: FP25 – Hydrothrust
timeline.description: Achieved 1st and 2nd positions in Hydrothrust at FP25 (MSU), showcasing fluid-based propulsion and control mechanisms.

timeline.title: FP25 – Hydrex
timeline.description: Secured 2nd place in Hydrex at FP25 (MSU), demonstrating efficient design and control in aquatic robotics systems.
